steps.content: The tiger's roar shakes the forest. The bet is on.

The white tiger crouches down, then moves so fast she becomes a blur. In an instant, she's already circled to your left, clawing the ground and sending up sprays of snow. Before you can turn around, she bounds to your right, a low growl rumbling in her throat, keeping you trapped within striking distance.
You sink into a half-crouch, shifting your weight to your lower body as your eyes track the tiger's every movement.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Hehe, look at my big kitty, getting all fired up at the sight of fresh prey. So fierce, just like her master!
The Mountain Lord remains hidden in the shadows. As for Shuang'er, the "prize" of this wager, she was tossed up onto a high branch by the tiger before the duel began, now hanging there in the air.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What are you so smug about? You want to be entertained, yet you don't even dare show yourself! If you like skulking in the dark so much, perhaps you should call yourself the Rat Mountain Lord instead!
Shuang'er is struggling to climb down from the tree when several pine needles whoosh past her and land next to her sleeves. She immediately shrinks back up.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Well, the one doing the fighting isn't complaining! Stay put and keep quiet! What? Think that little rascal might lose?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Are you kidding me? D-do you know who he is? He's... he's the 18th generation disciple of a secret elite swordsman fellowship! He practices the Supreme Sovereign Domination sword technique! You... you should be shaking in fear!
steps.female_content: Are you kidding me? D-do you know who she is? She's... she's the 18th generation disciple of a secret elite swordsman fellowship! She practices the Supreme Sovereign Domination sword technique! You... you should be shaking in fear!

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Oh, give it a rest. That's all you can come up with? Just watch, Meowy will soon obliterate that little rascal...

steps.speaker: Both
steps.content: Huh?
Once they're done bickering, they find that you have already vanished from the clearing.
You're not an idiot. No way you would fight a tiger head-on.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: What a fleet-footed runner... He didn't just abandon you and run off, did he?
steps.female_content: What a fleet-footed runner... She didn't just abandon you and run off, did she?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What do you know? This is called strategy.
Being hung so high up, from her vantage point, Shuang'er can see you dive into the densest thicket scattered with rocks.
Tigers excel at pouncing on prey on spacious terrain, so you deliberately choose an area full of obstacles.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: That's indeed quite clever, but surely a human can't match the speed of such a majestic beast.
As she says that, a bloodthirsty blow almost reaches your head! You frantically dodge the first strike, but an equally fierce second one quickly follows, aiming straight at your face.
You raise your sword sheath to block the attack, and with a resounding "bang," the impact sends you staggering back several steps, your hand going numb from the shock.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What... Those are killing blows... What did we ever do to you to deserve this?

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: What's the fun if no blood is drawn? If you really want a reason... Well, you disturbed my sleep. Does that count?
Shuang'er wants to protest, but seeing you in such peril, her anxiety makes her swallow her words.
The white tiger's assault is so violent, forcing you to dodge repeatedly as her powerful claws tear several gashes in the front of your clothes.
But this is what you've been waiting for. As the tiger pounces through the air once more, you duck down and squeeze into the gap between two massive boulders.

Just as the tiger's head is about to get trapped in the gap, crisp rings of a bell cut through the air! The white tiger twists her body unnaturally in mid-air to change direction, and slams her massive paw down, pinning you heavily to the ground.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: A tiger-taming bell? What sort of martial master cheats against opponents like us?!

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: It's not against the rules. Besides, even if it is, I can't read. This round goes to me.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Hey, you on the ground. Do you have a problem with that?
The tiger halts and doesn't try to kill you, obviously holding back. You struggle free from her claws with only minor scrapes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You waited until the last moment to use this unique skill. I had all the time to gain an advantage earlier. I shall not complain.
You give Shuang'er a reassuring look and brush the snow off your clothes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's continue.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: You fought bravely. I won't be holding back in the second round.
The bell rings again, and the tiger stirs once more.

The tiger's attacks are clearly more methodical this time. Its movements are well positioned, while its claws strike with immense force. You recall Yin Yansheng's comment that this Mountain Lord's martial arts embodied the savage gust of the mountains, and you can see it right now.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Such finesse beneath the savagery... Be careful, it won't be so easy to handle this time.

You understand the situation just as well. All that dodging has already exhausted most of your stamina. This round can only be won through strategy. You suddenly change course, no longer running in straight lines, instead weaving quickly around several old pine trees.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Hmm, not bad, lad! I thought you ducked into the trees only to buy time, but you had this move planned out too. Too bad a tiger never misses its pre... Huh?
steps.female_content: Hmm, not bad, lass! I thought you ducked into the trees only to buy time, but you had this move planned out too. Too bad a tiger never misses its pre... Huh?

steps.content: She goes silent abruptly. Throughout the dense forest, rapid knocks echo from all directions, their sources impossible to pinpoint.

You had noticed earlier that many tree trunks were hollowed out by insects and would produce different sounds when struck. Now, hiding in the underbrush, you throw snowballs at the hollow trees. The thuds and cracks echo throughout the area, creating a distracting cacophony.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Was this planned too?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh! Tigers are blessed with sharp hearing and keen sight. In the first round, Meowy was a tough opponent when she was acting on her own. But this round, Meowy follows your bell instead, so she's relying on your ears and eyes, Mountain Lord!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You've said it yourself, Mountain Lord. A human can't match a tiger's speed. And human senses are even worse! No matter what divine hiding skills you have, you're still just a mortal after all!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Keep explaining and she'll catch on. Stop chattering—give me the staff!
Upon hearing this, Shuang'er immediately tosses her staff down.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Too late. I've figured it out! Meowy, ignore my commands and find him!
steps.female_content: Too late. I've figured it out! Meowy, ignore my commands and find her!

steps.content: The bell stops ringing. The tiger pricks up its ears and pounces fiercely toward some rustling undergrowth. Yet it catches nothing, stumbling comically to one side.
Several pine branches tied to a long staff emerge from the bushes, swishing left and right before being hurled into the distance. Without a second thought, the tiger bounds after the swaying object.
A giant cat teaser you fashioned from Shuang'er's staff.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: A temptation no cat can resist. Even a big cat! Round two goes to us!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh my dear Mountain Lord! After all, you're no match for the mighty alliance of Shuang'er and our young hero—mmmph?
A snowball plugs her mouth precisely.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: What a chatterbox. You're giving me a headache.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Do you really think me a mere mortal with dull senses? Today I'll show you little runts what it means to be the Lord of all mountain beasts!
The wind blowing through the forest suddenly stills, and snowflakes tremble to a halt in the air.
You have a bad feeling and grip your sword hilt with both hands, the shackles poised under your sleeve. That hearty yet domineering voice rumbles down from above like muffled thunder.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: First round, smooth, but far from enough power. Second round, plenty of clever tricks, all built on a weak foundation.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Do you want to know the result of the third round?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can the Mountain Lord predict the future too?
She sneers, ignoring your provocation.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Third round...
The earth shakes violently, and the world spins! An invisible force hurls you off the ground, then an irresistible pressure crashes down like the sky has collapsed, slamming you hard into the snow!
[Big CG: Tiger Kneading]

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: You are bound to lose.
